description: Office of the Constitutional Council - Constitutional Council Rules No. 01 of 2023
reasoning: This gazette contains rules made by the Constitutional Council under specific articles of the Constitution (Articles 41G, 41B, 41C, 41D, and 41E). It establishes legal procedures and regulatory frameworks for the appointment of officials, functions of the Council and Secretary-General, and the operation of constitutional commissions. This content falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
